items.html: One may answer: certainly there are illuminations that also issue from the hidden Mocha to the outside. But the Avira encompasses the hidden Mocha, as above; and the thirteen locks of hair issue only from the second head, called the Avira. However, since the lights rise from within the hidden Mocha and pass through the Avira that encompasses it, of necessity the lights mingle together and become clothed within the locks of hair — even though the locks are more superior than they are, being that they issue from the second brain and not from the third.
